catalogue_title: Free Learning Resource Catalogue — Java SDET and Backend Career Platform

priority_legend.P0: Essential before or during initial job applications
priority_legend.P1: Important and should appear in projects or interview preparation
priority_legend.P3: Optional, role-specific or advanced; postpone unless demanded by target jobs

resource_schema.module_no: One or more curriculum module numbers
resource_schema.title: Display title
resource_schema.resource_type: Documentation, course, video, practice, reference, etc.

resources.title: Learn Java
resources.use: Primary learning hub for modern Java language features, APIs, JVM topics and practical tutorials.
resources.notes: Prefer this over the legacy Java 8 tutorial for current learning.

resources.title: Java Language Basics
resources.use: Structured starting point for syntax, variables, operators, control flow and language fundamentals.
resources.notes: Use before collections and streams.

resources.title: The Collections Framework
resources.use: Explains collection interfaces, implementations, iteration and common usage patterns.
resources.notes: Pair with coding exercises in R009 and R010.

resources.title: Processing Data in Memory Using the Stream API
resources.use: Modern Java stream pipelines, reduction, collectors and common data-processing patterns.
resources.notes: Complete after collections and lambdas.

resources.title: Virtual Threads and Concurrency Learning Paths
resources.use: Use the concurrency and virtual-thread sections to understand thread safety, executors and modern Java concurrency.
resources.notes: Automation learners need working knowledge; backend learners should go deeper.

resources.title: Java SE 21 API Documentation
resources.use: Authoritative class and method reference for the Java standard library.
resources.notes: Teach learners to navigate API docs instead of memorising methods.

resources.title: Java Programming MOOC
resources.access: Free; account may be required for exercise tooling
resources.use: Highly practical course with many programming exercises and automatic feedback.
resources.notes: Legacy and no longer actively maintained; use for practice, not for the latest Java features.

resources.title: Java Programming
resources.use: Beginner-friendly Java course designed for people entering test automation.
resources.notes: Strong first video course for QA learners transitioning to Java.

resources.title: Java Track
resources.use: Concept-based exercises with automated tests and community mentoring.
resources.notes: Assign exercises after each Java topic.

resources.title: CodingBat Java
resources.use: Short browser-based practice for strings, arrays, maps, recursion and warm-up logic.
resources.notes: Useful for daily streaks and interview warm-ups.

resources.title: Introduction to Algorithms (6.006)
resources.use: Rigorous algorithms course for Software Engineer I and backend interview depth.
resources.notes: Automation learners can select arrays, hashing, searching, sorting and complexity first.

resources.title: OpenDSA
resources.use: Interactive explanations and visualisations for core data structures and algorithms.
resources.notes: Use as a reference alongside coding practice.

resources.title: VisuAlgo
resources.use: Visual demonstrations of data structures and algorithms before implementation practice.
resources.notes: Supplementary; not a substitute for coding.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial
resources.use: Official introduction to relational concepts, SQL querying, joins, aggregates and advanced features.
resources.notes: Use PostgreSQL as the default project database.

resources.title: SQLBolt
resources.use: Browser-based SQL lessons with immediate exercises.
resources.notes: Ideal first SQL practice resource.

resources.title: PGExercises
resources.use: Practice PostgreSQL queries from simple SELECT statements to recursive and window queries.
resources.notes: Use after SQLBolt.

resources.title: Overview of HTTP
resources.use: Clear conceptual foundation for HTTP messages, clients, servers, proxies and sessions.
resources.notes: Required before API development or API automation.

resources.title: HTTP Request Methods
resources.use: Reference for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and method semantics.
resources.notes: Pair with idempotency exercises.

resources.title: HTTP Response Status Codes
resources.use: Authoritative quick reference for successful, redirect, client-error and server-error responses.
resources.notes: Create practice cards around common codes.

resources.title: Postman Learning Center
resources.access: Free documentation; app account may be required for some features
resources.use: Covers requests, collections, variables, environments, scripts, runners, mocks and documentation.
resources.notes: Use as the default manual API exploration tool.

resources.title: Everything curl — Tutorial
resources.use: Learn to make and debug API requests directly from the command line.
resources.notes: Useful in CI, containers and production diagnostics.

resources.title: Pro Git
resources.provider: Git Project / Scott Chacon and Ben Straub
resources.use: Authoritative book for Git fundamentals, branching, remotes, internals and workflows.
resources.notes: Read chapters 1–3 first.

resources.title: GitHub Skills
resources.use: Hands-on repositories teach pull requests, Actions, Markdown, code review and release workflows.
resources.notes: Excellent onboarding content for platform projects.

resources.title: Learn Git Branching
resources.use: Visual exercises for commits, branches, merge, rebase, reset and remote workflows.
resources.notes: Use after basic Git commands.

resources.title: Maven in Five Minutes
resources.use: Creates a first Maven project and explains essential commands and structure.
resources.notes: First Maven activity.

resources.title: Maven Getting Started Guide
resources.use: Dependency management, plugins, builds, resources, tests and project conventions.
resources.notes: Reference while building both portfolio projects.

resources.title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education
resources.use: Practical shell, command-line tools, Git, debugging, data wrangling and developer workflow.
resources.notes: Use selected lectures rather than forcing the full course.

resources.title: Linux Journey
resources.use: Friendly introduction to command line, permissions, processes, networking and system administration basics.
resources.notes: Prioritise command line, text processing, processes and networking.

resources.title: Debug Code in IntelliJ IDEA
resources.use: Breakpoints, stepping, watches, expression evaluation and debugger workflows.
resources.notes: Require learners to debug a failing test and backend exception.

resources.title: Chrome DevTools Documentation
resources.use: Inspect DOM, network requests, console errors, storage, performance and device emulation.
resources.notes: Essential for diagnosing UI and API integration failures.

resources.title: Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) Syllabus and Sample Exams
resources.access: Free learning documents; certification exam is paid
resources.use: Structured source for testing principles, test design techniques, defect management and test activities.
resources.notes: Use the syllabus as learning content without requiring certification.

resources.title: Selenium Overview
resources.use: Introduces Selenium components, WebDriver and how browser automation works.
resources.notes: Start here before WebDriver API details.

resources.title: WebDriver Documentation
resources.use: Authoritative WebDriver guide covering browsers, elements, interactions, waits and support features.
resources.notes: Core Selenium reference.

resources.title: Locator Strategies
resources.use: Reliable element selection with ID, name, CSS and XPath strategies.
resources.notes: Add exercises comparing locator stability.

resources.title: Waiting Strategies
resources.use: Explains implicit and explicit waits and the risks of mixing strategies.
resources.notes: Pair with flaky-test debugging labs.

resources.title: Page Object Models
resources.use: Official rationale and patterns for separating test logic from page interactions.
resources.notes: Use as the minimum framework architecture pattern.

resources.title: Getting Started with Selenium Grid
resources.use: Run tests remotely and in parallel across browsers and machines.
resources.notes: Learn after local framework stability.

resources.title: Selenium WebDriver with Java
resources.use: Practical Selenium Java course with browser automation examples and test structure.
resources.notes: Use alongside official Selenium documentation.

resources.title: TestNG Documentation
resources.use: Annotations, assertions, parameters, data providers, groups, listeners and parallel test execution.
resources.notes: Primary test runner for the automation project.

resources.title: JUnit 5 User Guide
resources.use: Unit-test lifecycle, assertions, parameterized tests, extensions and platform integration.
resources.notes: Required for backend; automation learners should understand it even if using TestNG.

resources.title: Cucumber Documentation
resources.use: Gherkin, scenarios, step definitions, hooks and Cucumber framework integration.
resources.notes: Use only after understanding test design and framework architecture.

resources.title: Behaviour-Driven Development
resources.use: Explains BDD as a collaboration practice rather than merely a Gherkin syntax tool.
resources.notes: Important to avoid writing low-value, UI-heavy BDD suites.

resources.title: REST Assured Usage Guide
resources.use: Requests, response assertions, authentication, object mapping, JSON/XML parsing and reusable specifications.
resources.notes: Core API automation reference.

resources.title: REST Assured Course
resources.use: Practical progression from basic requests to a maintainable API automation suite.
resources.notes: Use as the guided course paired with R043.

resources.title: Write Scripts in Postman
resources.use: Pre-request and post-response scripting for validation, chaining and dynamic data.
resources.notes: Good bridge from manual API testing to Java automation.

resources.title: JsonPath for Java
resources.use: Query and extract values from JSON documents for API validation and data chaining.
resources.notes: Supplement REST Assured JsonPath knowledge.

resources.title: WireMock Documentation
resources.use: Stub HTTP services, simulate latency and failures, and test third-party integrations.
resources.notes: Excellent advanced SDET and backend-testing skill.

resources.title: Testcontainers for Java — JUnit 5 Quickstart
resources.use: Run disposable real dependencies such as PostgreSQL during integration tests.
resources.notes: Use after Docker fundamentals.

resources.title: Mockito Documentation
resources.use: Mock dependencies and isolate unit tests using mocks, stubs, spies and verification.
resources.notes: Backend P0; automation P1 for framework and utility testing.

resources.title: Testing the Web Layer
resources.use: Test Spring MVC controllers with MockMvc without starting the complete server.
resources.notes: Useful for SDETs working close to backend code.

resources.title: Build and Test Java with Maven in GitHub Actions
resources.access: Free documentation; GitHub Actions free allowances depend on plan/repository
resources.use: Configure CI to build Java, cache Maven dependencies and execute tests on every change.
resources.notes: Mandatory in both portfolio projects.

resources.title: Using a Jenkinsfile
resources.use: Declarative pipelines, stages, agents, environment variables and credentials.
resources.notes: Learn after GitHub Actions; many enterprises still use Jenkins.

resources.title: Docker Get Started
resources.access: Free documentation; product licensing varies by organisation
resources.use: Images, containers, Dockerfiles, ports, volumes, networks and container workflows.
resources.notes: Use before Testcontainers and deployment exercises.

resources.title: Docker Compose Quickstart
resources.use: Run an application, database and supporting services together from a Compose file.
resources.notes: Use in the backend portfolio project.

resources.title: Get Started with k6
resources.access: Free documentation; k6 open source available
resources.use: Script and run API load tests, inspect metrics and define performance thresholds.
resources.notes: Choose k6 or JMeter initially, not both deeply.

resources.title: Apache JMeter User Manual
resources.use: Create HTTP load tests, parameterise data, use assertions and analyse results.
resources.notes: Useful where JMeter appears in job descriptions.

resources.title: Web Accessibility Tutorials
resources.use: Practical accessibility guidance for forms, images, tables, menus and page structure.
resources.notes: Optional differentiator for QA automation.

resources.title: Appium Documentation
resources.use: Mobile application automation setup, drivers, sessions and element interaction.
resources.notes: Only after web and API automation unless targeting mobile roles.

resources.title: Pact Documentation
resources.use: Consumer-driven contract testing for independently deployed services.
resources.notes: Advanced differentiator for SDET and microservice teams.

resources.title: Spring Cloud Contract Reference
resources.use: Contract-driven testing and stub generation in Spring ecosystems.
resources.notes: Choose Pact or Spring Cloud Contract based on the target stack.

resources.title: The Internet — Test Practice Site
resources.access: Free public demo; availability is not guaranteed
resources.use: Small isolated browser scenarios for locators, waits, alerts, frames, uploads and dynamic elements.
resources.notes: External demo site; do not depend on it for production assessments.

resources.title: Sauce Demo
resources.access: Free public demo; availability is not guaranteed
resources.use: Automate a small end-to-end e-commerce flow including login, inventory, cart and checkout.
resources.notes: Good beginner portfolio mini-project.

resources.title: UI Test Automation Playground
resources.access: Free public demo; availability is not guaranteed
resources.use: Purpose-built challenges for dynamic IDs, waits, scrolling, AJAX, shadow DOM and automation pitfalls.
resources.notes: Use for debugging and robust-locator exercises.

resources.title: Restful Booker
resources.provider: Mark Winteringham / Ministry of Testing community
resources.access: Free public demo; data resets and availability may vary
resources.use: CRUD, authentication, request chaining and negative API tests against a realistic booking service.
resources.notes: Do not store sensitive data.

resources.title: JSONPlaceholder
resources.use: Quick practice for GET, POST, JSON parsing and client integration.
resources.notes: Writes are simulated, not persisted.

resources.title: httpbin
resources.access: Free public service; availability may vary
resources.use: Inspect requests and test headers, authentication, redirects, delays, cookies and response codes.
resources.notes: Excellent for HTTP fundamentals and debugging labs.

resources.title: DummyJSON
resources.use: Practice CRUD-like requests, authentication, pagination, filtering and nested JSON.
resources.notes: Use as supplementary practice; writes may be simulated.

resources.title: Spring Guides
resources.use: Curated, runnable guides for REST, data access, security, messaging, testing and cloud patterns.
resources.notes: Use as the main practical sequence for backend learners.

resources.title: Building an Application with Spring Boot
resources.use: Creates a first Spring Boot application and explains auto-configuration and application startup.
resources.notes: First backend lab.

resources.title: Building a RESTful Web Service
resources.use: Build a simple REST endpoint with Spring Boot and JSON responses.
resources.notes: Extend it with validation and error handling.

resources.title: Accessing Data with JPA
resources.use: Introduces JPA entities, repositories and database persistence in Spring Boot.
resources.notes: Follow with PostgreSQL rather than remaining on an in-memory database.

resources.title: Spring Data JPA Reference
resources.use: Repositories, query methods, custom queries, specifications, projections, transactions and auditing.
resources.notes: Use selectively alongside the backend project.

resources.title: Hibernate ORM Getting Started
resources.use: ORM fundamentals, mappings, sessions/entity managers and persistence concepts.
resources.notes: Use to understand what Spring Data JPA abstracts.

resources.title: Flyway Documentation
resources.use: Version and apply database schema changes consistently across environments.
resources.notes: Use Flyway or Liquibase, not both in the first project.

resources.title: Liquibase Get Started
resources.use: Alternative migration tool using changelogs and repeatable deployment workflows.
resources.notes: Optional alternative to Flyway.

resources.title: Spring MVC Exception Handling
resources.use: Build centralised, consistent API error responses with exception handlers and controller advice.
resources.notes: Require a documented error model in the backend project.

resources.title: Testing Spring Boot Applications
resources.use: Test slices, application contexts, web tests, test utilities and integration-test configuration.
resources.notes: Pair with JUnit, Mockito and Testcontainers.

resources.title: Spring Security Reference
resources.use: Authentication, authorisation, filters, method security, OAuth2, resource servers and secure configuration.
resources.notes: Use selected sections; do not attempt the whole reference at once.

resources.title: Securing a Web Application
resources.use: Practical introduction to Spring Security configuration and protected resources.
resources.notes: Extend to stateless API authentication in the portfolio project.

resources.title: Learn OpenAPI
resources.use: Understand OpenAPI structure, operations, parameters, schemas, responses and reusable components.
resources.notes: Use before generating or reviewing Swagger documentation.

resources.title: OpenAPI Specification Guide
resources.use: Practical OpenAPI 3 guide with request, response, authentication and schema examples.
resources.notes: Use to document the project API completely.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10
resources.use: Core awareness of common web application security risks and mitigations.
resources.notes: Use the current released edition and update platform content when OWASP changes it.

resources.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
resources.use: Actionable secure-coding guidance for authentication, REST, input validation, secrets, logging and SQL injection.
resources.notes: Link specific cheat sheets to matching lessons.

resources.title: Web Security Academy
resources.use: Hands-on labs for authentication, access control, injection, CSRF, CORS and API security.
resources.notes: Use only within the authorised training labs.

resources.title: SLF4J User Manual
resources.use: Logging API, placeholders, levels and integration with logging implementations.
resources.notes: Teach parameterised logging and avoidance of sensitive data.

resources.title: Logback Manual
resources.use: Configure appenders, formats, rolling files, levels and structured application logging.
resources.notes: Use selected chapters in the project.

resources.title: Spring Boot Actuator
resources.use: Expose health, metrics, environment and operational endpoints safely.
resources.notes: Add health and metrics endpoints to the backend project.

resources.title: Micrometer Reference
resources.use: Instrument JVM and application metrics with a vendor-neutral facade.
resources.notes: Learn after Actuator.

resources.title: Prometheus Getting Started
resources.use: Collect time-series metrics, configure scrape targets and run basic PromQL queries.
resources.notes: Optional after application metrics are working.

resources.title: Grafana Tutorials
resources.use: Build dashboards and visualise application or infrastructure metrics.
resources.notes: Use for the optional monitoring dashboard portfolio evidence.

resources.title: OpenTelemetry Java
resources.use: Instrument Java services for traces, metrics and logs using open standards.
resources.notes: Advanced after logging and metrics fundamentals.

resources.title: Resilience4j Documentation
resources.use: Implement retries, circuit breakers, rate limiters, bulkheads and time limiters.
resources.notes: Do not add resilience patterns without failure scenarios and metrics.

resources.title: Microservice Architecture Patterns
resources.use: Pattern catalogue for decomposition, data consistency, communication, observability and deployment.
resources.notes: Use as a reference, not as a first architecture course.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Books
resources.use: Reliability principles, service-level objectives, monitoring, incident response and operational practices.
resources.notes: Select chapters relevant to junior backend projects.

resources.title: Apache Kafka Documentation
resources.use: Core Kafka concepts, clients, configuration, delivery semantics and operations.
resources.notes: Backend optional until the main API project is complete.

resources.title: Kafka Courses
resources.use: Guided practical learning for Kafka fundamentals, streams and event-driven applications.
resources.notes: Use before deep-diving into broker configuration.

resources.title: RabbitMQ Tutorials
resources.use: Hands-on queues, work distribution, publish/subscribe, routing and topics.
resources.notes: Choose Kafka or RabbitMQ based on target job demand.

resources.title: Redis Developer Documentation
resources.use: Redis data types, clients, caching patterns, expiration and application integration.
resources.notes: Learn cache invalidation and failure behaviour, not only commands.

resources.title: AWS Skill Builder — Free Digital Training
resources.access: Free tier of courses available; account required
resources.use: AWS fundamentals, IAM, compute, storage, databases, containers and cloud operations.
resources.notes: Select fundamentals and developer learning plans; do not attempt every service.

resources.title: Microsoft Learn for Azure
resources.access: Free; account optional for browsing and useful for tracking
resources.use: Guided modules for cloud concepts, application services, containers, identity and databases.
resources.notes: Choose one cloud platform initially.

resources.title: Learn Kubernetes Basics
resources.use: Deploy, scale, update and debug a containerised application on Kubernetes.
resources.notes: Optional after Docker and deployment fundamentals.

resources.title: Terraform Tutorials
resources.use: Infrastructure-as-code concepts, providers, state and reusable configuration.
resources.notes: Optional for the target junior roles.

resources.title: System Design Primer
resources.use: Structured introduction to scalability, availability, load balancing, caching, databases and design interviews.
resources.notes: Use selected beginner sections for Software Engineer I interviews.

resources.title: Mermaid Documentation
resources.use: Create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams and architecture visuals from text.
resources.notes: Good for README and technical documentation.

resources.title: PlantUML Guide
resources.use: Text-based UML, sequence, component, deployment and entity-relationship diagrams.
resources.notes: Choose Mermaid or PlantUML for the first project.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Learn Web Development
resources.use: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility and web platform fundamentals.
resources.notes: Optional for target roles; use selected sections to understand applications under test.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: React Learn
resources.use: Modern React components, state, hooks, forms and application thinking.
resources.notes: Optional; useful only for full-stack projects or deeper UI understanding.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Material UI Getting Started
resources.use: Build accessible React interfaces using a mature component library and theming system.
resources.notes: Optional for an admin dashboard portfolio extension.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Material Design 3
resources.use: Guidance for visual hierarchy, components, interaction, accessibility and responsive design.
resources.notes: Optional; useful for improving project presentation.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: DBeaver Documentation
resources.use: Connect to databases, browse schemas, run queries, inspect plans and export data.
resources.notes: Use as a practical database client, not as a replacement for SQL knowledge.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: IntelliJ IDEA Documentation
resources.use: Project navigation, refactoring, inspections, Maven, Git, database tools and productivity workflows.
resources.notes: Link specific pages from each practical task.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: SonarQube Documentation
resources.use: Static analysis, code smells, vulnerabilities, duplication, coverage and quality gates.
resources.notes: Add an optional quality-gate exercise in CI.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: JaCoCo Documentation
resources.use: Generate Java test-coverage reports and integrate coverage into Maven builds.
resources.notes: Teach coverage as a signal, not a quality guarantee.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: SpotBugs Documentation
resources.use: Detect common Java bug patterns during builds and code review.
resources.notes: Optional after tests and Sonar are established.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: OWASP Dependency-Check
resources.use: Identify known vulnerable third-party dependencies in Java builds and CI.
resources.notes: Use with careful triage of false positives and update policies.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Teach Yourself Computer Science
resources.use: Long-term map for programming, architecture, algorithms, operating systems, networking and databases.
resources.notes: Use selectively; not a prerequisite for applications.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Responsible Use of GitHub Copilot Features
resources.access: Free documentation; Copilot product access may require a plan
resources.use: Risks, limitations, review requirements, privacy and responsible validation of AI-generated code.
resources.notes: The platform should teach verification, security and attribution—not blind copying.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Agile Coach
resources.use: Agile principles, Scrum, Kanban, planning, retrospectives, user stories and team practices.
resources.notes: Pair theory with project boards and pull-request workflows.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Technical Writing Courses
resources.use: Clear sentences, paragraphs, audience awareness and technical-document structure.
resources.notes: Apply directly to README, API and architecture documentation.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: About READMEs
resources.use: Create a clear repository landing page with setup, architecture, usage, tests and project evidence.
resources.notes: Every portfolio project must include a professional README.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: GitHub Pages
resources.use: Publish a simple project portfolio or documentation site directly from a repository.
resources.notes: Optional presentation upgrade.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Spring Petclinic
resources.use: Study the structure, configuration, testing and conventions of a maintained Spring application.
resources.notes: Do not copy it as a portfolio project; use it for architecture reading.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Selenium Documentation Examples
resources.use: Official example code used by Selenium documentation in several languages.
resources.notes: Use to compare API usage and idioms.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: OWASP Juice Shop
resources.use: Authorised security training application with challenges and documentation.
resources.notes: Run locally or use official training instances; never attack systems without permission.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: HackerRank Java
resources.use: Java language and coding challenges for interview practice and syntax fluency.
resources.notes: Use selected easy and medium problems.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: HackerRank SQL
resources.use: Progressive SQL questions covering selection, aggregation, joins and advanced queries.
resources.notes: Pair with PostgreSQL project queries.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: LeetCode Problemset
resources.access: Many problems free; premium features optional
resources.use: Targeted easy and medium problems for Software Engineer I and backend interviews.
resources.notes: Use a curated list; avoid random high-volume grinding.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Java Developer Roadmap
resources.access: Free core content; account features may vary
resources.use: Visual overview of Java developer topics and possible learning order.
resources.notes: Community roadmap; use only as supplementary orientation.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: QA Roadmap
resources.access: Free core content; account features may vary
resources.use: Visual map of testing, automation, API, performance and quality-engineering topics.
resources.notes: Community roadmap; platform priorities should override it.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Public APIs List
resources.access: Free directory; individual APIs have different terms
resources.use: Find public APIs for integration and automation practice.
resources.notes: Verify each API’s availability, authentication, terms and data policy before use.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Testcontainers Java Examples
resources.use: Working examples for databases, services and integration-test patterns.
resources.notes: Use after the quickstart and Docker basics.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Java Full Course
resources.access: Free video; Class Central landing page links to YouTube
resources.use: Concise video-led introduction to Java syntax, development setup, control flow, methods, classes and objects.
resources.notes: Use as a supplementary video path alongside current official Java documentation.

resources.section: Professional practice, optional skills and portfolio
resources.title: Spring Boot Tutorial for Beginners — Full Course 2025
resources.access: Free video; Class Central landing page links to YouTube
resources.use: Fast visual introduction to creating and structuring a modern Spring Boot application.
resources.notes: Use after the official Spring Boot guide; verify examples against current Spring documentation.
